<!-- One entry per pull request, please. See contributing.md. -->

**What you are adding and why it belongs:**

- [ ] It helps someone build, verify, regulate or understand an EUDI Wallet implementation.
- [ ] It is maintained (commits in the last two years) and not archived.
- [ ] It is not a marketing page or a blog post.
- [ ] Format is `- [Name](link) - Description ending with a period.`, one line, no superlatives.
- [ ] It is not already in the list.
